nodes.label: Review Cleanup and Python 3.11 Rerun (spec)
nodes.rationale: A two-axis review of the ticket 07 work found the primary and PR paths share almost no code where they are meant to behave identically, the new CLIs had no tests, and the primary config computed a categorical-feature tuple that always yields nothing (suggesting the deployed model could use state, religion, or social group). The refactors collapse duplicated config, subgroup, reconciliation, and summary logic behind existing seams, merge the two comparison accessors, and add CLI guard tests, all behaviour-preserving: the only changed numbers should come from the rerun.

nodes.label: Amendment: Python 3.11 Rerun Withdrawn
nodes.rationale: The 1 November 2026 amendment withdraws the rerun half and deletes ticket 06: the premise was wrong because every dependency ships a cp314 wheel, the CUDA and CatBoost GPU paths are verified, and the suite passes on 3.14.6, so the README now names 3.14.6. The rerun work belongs to model-shortlist tickets 05 and 06, which replace all three run directories under a new recipe; running this spec's rerun first would produce three full runs of the old recipe and then delete them. Tickets 02-05 carry forward, and 03/04 should land before model-shortlist 01/02 so the new families extend one config path.

nodes.label: One Shared Config Assembly Path
nodes.rationale: The public config builders stay the interface; behind them one internal assembler builds the shared pipeline config shape (target columns and definition, cluster/household/weight columns, folds, test fraction, sensitivity, bootstrap, SHAP sample size, split assignment, smoke rows, metadata) while each family supplies only run name, feature columns, sample filters, age bands and labels, subgroup extras, role, and sample label. The shared subgroup set and the 15-49 bands/labels are declared once, and the primary config's always-empty categorical tuple and its backing constant are deleted so nothing suggests the deployed model can use state, religion, or social group.

nodes.label: One Shared Run Summary Function
nodes.rationale: Both run entry points should print their end-of-run summary from one library function that takes the pipeline result plus the smoke flag, reconciliation status, and documented counts, so the primary and PR runs cannot drift in reported fields. It touches no filesystem and trains nothing, so it is unit-testable against a fake result in seconds. Row counts go through one accessor on the run result rather than repeated nested metadata lookups, so a metadata-shape change breaks one line.

nodes.label: One Reconciliation Rule and One Declaration per Count
nodes.rationale: All four reconcilers - PR feature-table audit, PR BP-valid 15+, PR BP-valid 15-49, and primary 15-49 - should delegate to one comparison helper while keeping the existing {status, summary, checks} shape so serialized run metadata does not change. Each documented count is declared once per sample, so a recount is a one-place edit rather than a hunt through constants, tests, and prose.

nodes.label: One Comparison Accessor for Metrics and Run Fields
nodes.rationale: The two near-identical helpers in the comparison module (metric value within a named block, and run-level field such as the calibrator or selected model family) collapse into one accessor with a missing name returning the same value as today. Call sites and the renderer are updated, and the rendered report must stay byte-identical for unchanged inputs, so the refactor does not quietly change published text.
